title: FoodReact-AR: Learning Audience Reactions that Zero-Shot LLMs Miss in Arabic Food-Insecurity Discourse
abstract: arXiv:2611.25682v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Facebook reactions record how an audience received a post, a signal absent from the post's text. We treat the six differentiated reactions on 74,241 Arabic food-insecurity posts from public Facebook pages (2020-2024) as compositions, apply a centered log-ratio transformation, and cluster them into four audience profiles: Solidarity (Love-dominant), Dismissal (Haha-dominant), Grief (Sad-dominant), and a flat Ambivalent profile. Dismissal peaks in 2022 (22.3%), the year of the wheat price shock, and grief in 2024 (14.0%), during the Gaza food emergency; a page-clustered GEE confirms both shifts (odds ratios 2.18 and 1.34), and they survive minimum-reaction filtering, alternative zero replacements and clustering methods, and bootstrap resampling. translated_title: FoodReact-AR：学习零样本大语言模型在阿拉伯语粮食不安全话语中所遗漏的受众反应
translated_abstract: Facebook表情反应记录了受众如何接收一条帖子，这一信号在帖子文本中并不存在。我们将来自公共Facebook页面的74,241条阿拉伯语粮食不安全帖子（2020-2024年）上的六种差异化反应视为成分数据，应用中心对数比（CLR）变换，并将其聚类为四种受众画像：团结（以“爱”为主）、轻视（以“哈哈”为主）、悲伤（以“难过”为主）以及扁平的矛盾（Ambivalent）画像。轻视反应在2022年达到峰值（22.3%），即小麦价格冲击之年；悲伤反应在2024年达到峰值（14.0%），正值加沙粮食紧急状态期间。基于页面聚类的广义估计方程（GEE）证实了这两种转变（优势比分别为2.18和1.34），且这些结果在最小反应数过滤、替代零值替换与聚类方法以及自助重采样下依然稳健。随后，我们测试了能否在不依赖反应数据的情况下预测这些画像。零样本阿拉伯语大语言模型对83.8%的帖子正确识别出悲伤画像，但对轻视画像的识别率仅为3.4%；在匹配消融实验中，它表现出……（摘要此处截断）
tldr: 该研究将74,241条阿拉伯语粮食不安全Facebook帖子的表情反应聚类为四种受众画像，发现“轻视”与“悲伤”反应分别随2022年小麦价格冲击和2024年加沙粮食危机显著上升，而零样本阿拉伯语大语言模型虽能较好预测悲伤画像（83.8%）却几乎无法识别轻视画像（仅3.4%），揭示了文本中隐藏的受众反应信号。
en_tdlr: By clustering reactions from 74,241 Arabic food-insecurity Facebook posts into four audience profiles, this study shows that Dismissal and Grief responses shifted with real-world food crises (2022 wheat price shock and 2024 Gaza emergency), while a zero-shot Arabic LLM predicts Grief well (83.8%) but largely fails at Dismissal (3.4%), revealing audience signals missing from post text.
